title: Fall-Alert Response Log
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fall:alert
| eval responded=if(isnotnull(response_time),1,0), response_min=round((response_time-_time)/60,1)
| stats count as falls, sum(responded) as answered, avg(response_min) as avg_response
| eval unanswered=falls-answered
description: Records every fall-detection alert, whether someone responded, and how quickly, so care gaps are visible.
value: Knowing that alerts are actually reaching and being answered by a carer is the whole point of a fall detector.
implementation: Ingest fall-detector alerts and acknowledgements into `index=personal`; summarise response coverage.
visualization: Table of fall alerts with response status and time.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps a record of every fall alarm and whether someone answered it quickly, so no alert is ever missed.
